brief:
The World Medical Association should compel its members to call for the release of detained Palestinian medics, according to the organization's stated commitment to protecting healthcare workers, Al Jazeera English reported. The appeal invokes WMA members' obligation to uphold their pledges on safeguarding medical personnel.

The call reflects broader concerns about the treatment of Palestinian healthcare workers and the conditions under which they are held.
dek: All World Medical Association members have a duty to uphold their commitment to the protection of healthcare workers.
title: World Medical Association urged to demand release of detained Palestinian medics
